CROSS-REFERENCE — the observed coverage gap this ticket closes, from the 2026-08-12 alarm sweep (full text: session log cosey-vinegarish-mouflon (d0d8-9dfe-f2d8-4364) entry 3; originally mis-filed as childsafe-bizarre-lorikeet comment 12).

Concrete evidence for the gap: the JIRA_API_TOKEN expiry that ran until ~18:30Z on 2026-08-12 (healthy run at 18:34Z) produced ZERO alarm firings. rebar/host:voter_errors stayed 0 across the whole window, and at sweep time the rebar/host namespace carried 19 metric names with NO reconcile/bridge counter at all — so bridge auth failure was entirely invisible to CloudWatch. That is precisely the blind spot this ticket's bridge-failure publication + alarm removes.
